en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a small European town in a steep river valley, surrounded by wooded hills. In the foreground on the right stands a large villa with steep tiled roofs, multiple chimneys, half‑timbered details, and a terraced garden leading down a stairway. Below and into the distance stretch rows of 2‑3 story houses with pitched tile roofs along winding streets; electric poles line the road. On a hill farther back stands a sizable institutional building, likely a school or town hall, and a church with a slender tower rises from the middle distance. The landscape is hilly and partly forested; the overall scene has an early‑20th‑century Central European feel. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.
